title: Queue scan timeout and subtitle self-check telemetry
summary: Extend the queue-plan dry-run ceiling from 120 to 300 seconds and classify the intentional ASS helper no-argument exit as successful startup telemetry.
reason: A normal 98-file queue scan completed safe inventory but its authoritative queue-plan dry run was killed at the fixed 120-second ceiling. The ASS helper correctly returned its argparse usage exit code 2, but generic tool telemetry rendered that expected result as a failed startup event.
behavior_before: Queue-plan curation was force-killed after 120 seconds even when bounded source metadata probes were progressing normally. The ASS helper self-check treated exit code 2 as valid for launch control, but emitted a failed tool-completed event and PYTHON_FAILED evidence in the operator UI.
behavior_after: Queue-plan curation remains killable but has a 300-second outer ceiling. The ASS helper startup check explicitly accepts exit code 2 for telemetry, emits succeeded/OK evidence, and retains the existing launch block for unexpected exits when fallback is disabled.
manual_validation: Executed the bundled Python ASS helper without arguments and observed its documented argparse exit code 2.
GREEN: targeted Python queue-runner tests, native-process cleanup checks, and pipeline queue-engine checks passed after the change.

Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks reached architecture, native-process, runtime-hygiene, and sidecar-safety passes, then failed an existing WebView release-self-test static expectation unrelated to this change.

Observed queue_scan_status.json for scan 20260710T004652Z-b8192ccddc: 98 inventory candidates completed before the queue-plan dry run exceeded 120 seconds and was force-killed; no source mutation was reported.
RED: tests.python.desktop.test_service_queue_dry_run_runner failed while the ceiling was 120 seconds; Invoke-PipelineQueueEngineChecks failed while expected-exit telemetry wiring was absent.

Targeted queue runner tests, native process cleanup checks, pipeline queue-engine checks, Python compile check, and bundled tool integration checks passed; broad reliability wrapper blocked by an unrelated WebView release-self-test static expectation.
rollback_plan: Restore QueueServiceMixin.QUEUE_DRY_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to 120.0 and remove the optional SuccessExitCodes plumbing plus the self-check's explicit @(0, 2) allowlist. This changes only queue-plan timing and telemetry classification; it does not require source, scratch, output, or manifest recovery.
